headline: Weathered Expanse Cools as Linn Mercy Flare Rises
war_summary: Three hours on the wires find Weathered Expanse easing to two changes in the last two hours against sixty-one in the day around Spirit Watch, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, now counted at three Warden, three Colonial and three neutral after more than sixty-nine hundred Colonial and eighty-four hundred Warden casualties in the day, with the latest entry at the cutoff. Linn Mercy carries the late running with six changes in two hours and fourteen in the day centered on Outwich Ranch, listed at one Warden, nine Colonial and one neutral. Pari Peak adds one late change toward nineteen in the day around Pariah at one Warden and four Colonial, while Stlican Shelf posts two late changes toward fourteen in the day at Breaker Town at one Warden, seven Colonial and one neutral. Marban Hollow and Kuura Strand have gone quiet in the last two hours despite thirty-five and ten changes in the day, and Gutter and Olavis Wake remain still after sixty-four and fourteen. Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle still report heavy daily losses without a recorded change.
